description: Multi-VM scenario delivering 3 Ubuntu LTS hosts with the Docker baseline (docker, docker compose, zsh, curl, git, jq, vim, network utils) on vmbr142. Intended to host the deployer-ui platform (frontend, backend API, Kong API gateway) via docker-compose in a follow-up step. Bridge vmbr142, IPs 192.168.142.190-192, VMIDs 1190-1192 (convention : last 3 digits of vm_id match the IP last octet). Template VMID 9232 (template-vm-medium-02-8g-64g, 2cpu/8gb/64gb) is created by this scenario's 01_init_proxmox/ (idempotent : skipped if already present from another scenario such as misp_lab, blank_scenario_2_subnets or demo_lab). Only SSH (port 22) is opened by this scenario ; application ports for the deployer-ui frontend, backend API and Kong API gateway are opened later by the downstream docker-compose stack.
